name: delete_meeting
title: Delete meeting
description: Delete a meeting: its entire session bundle is moved to <NARUMI_HOME>/trash/<meeting_id>-<timestamp>/ (returned as `moved_to`) and the meeting is removed from the catalog. Nothing is erased immediately — a mistaken deletion can be undone by moving the directory back under meetings/ and calling rebuild_catalog; emptying the trash is a manual step outside this tool. `confirm` must be literally true (a client must not set it without an explicit user confirmation). `scope` is the scope selector (default deny: a scoped meeting needs its scope in the request). `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting_id), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), busy (the meeting is still recording, or a job is queued / running for it — cancel it first), invalid_argument (confirm missing or not true), internal.

scope.description: Omitted = unscoped meetings only. One name = that scope + unscoped. Array of 2+ names = cross-scope lookup (audit-logged).

confirm.description: Must be literally true. Guards against accidental deletion; only set it after an explicit user confirmation.

moved_to.description: Absolute path the bundle was moved to (<NARUMI_HOME>/trash/<meeting_id>-<timestamp>/).
